descriptionChirho: To conceal oneself from danger or detection, used reflexively in both Nifal and Hitpael stems of people actively hiding themselves.
To be in a state of concealment or to be hidden by another, expressed through passive forms (Nifal passive, Hofal, Pual) indicating the subject is acted upon rather than acting.
To actively conceal another person or object, used transitively in the Hifil causative stem with a direct object.
